periods.time: Night after the first Argonaut activation

name.zh: 赫斯缇雅解释【英雄愿望】

periods.summary: After dinner preparations, Bell reports that his new skill activated when he thought of heroes and his admiration. Hestia checks his status and interprets Heroic Desire / Argonaut as a reverse-force skill: a right to charge one decisive active strike that can overturn an overwhelming situation.
periods.cause: Bell's amplified Firebolt against the Infant Dragon reveals that Heroic Desire has a visible charge and attack-amplification effect.
periods.process: Bell describes the white particles, the charged attack, and his guess that a longer charge may produce a greater effect. Hestia inspects the Falna on his back and offers her divine interpretation.
periods.outcome: Bell understands the skill as 'a hero's strike' and a ticket that lets a hero-admiring child approach the path of heroes.
periods.aftermath: Bell is emotionally struck by Hestia's distant, divine tenderness and keeps the interpretation in his heart.
periods.significance: Defines the operating concept and narrative meaning of Bell's new skill: an accumulated heroic blow for impossible odds.
